_comment: Outcomes are a property of the APPLICATION, not of one flow, so every capability recorded against this product inherits the same vocabulary of answers. Where the server's status code says the same thing as the error text, prefer the status: 503 means the same at every tenant and in every language, and the wording on the page does not.
